Help him and his men put down Sarathstra and you'll be rewarded handsomely!

He drew the dagger to his own throat and with a smile, cut from ear to ear. His body collapsed inside the borders of the pentagram. Bring me his horn as proof and I will begin your advanced training as a warrior.$B$BThe path to the moonwell is hidden well, $N, but stay focused and alert and you will find it.

f8c6af08b1f27c23872b9a19cd3238216f7d7693.QuestDescription: Ah, yes - the fel reaver!  Certainly the Legion's most terrible mechanical creation.  There are no less than three of these abominations aimed at the Stormspire.$B$BFortunately for us, they are not active yet.  This affords us the possibility of dealing with them through sabotage instead of brute force.$B$BObtain condensed nether gas from the gan'arg at Forge Base: Oblivion and fill a nearby fel reaver's fuel tank with it.  I've a feeling its engine won't handle it too well.

It was unwise for Rhinag to hunt them without having some of the antidote with him, but right now, chastising is the last thing he needs.$B$BBring me a few venomtail poison sacs from any of the venomtails near the entrance of Orgrimmar and I'll make an antidote for him.$B$BMake haste, $N. f8fb9582c00cb8c25a7df08029a8e81e8b9edae0.QuestDescription: Master Mechanic Castpipe in Ironforge has need of adventurers!  He's organizing bands to reenter Gnomeregan on a data retrieval mission of top security and importance.$B$BCastpipe might not be a member of the Enlightened Assembly of Arcanology, Alchemy and Engineering Sciences like I am, but he's still a smart gnome so if he thinks it's important, then by my calculations there's an eighty-four percent probability that it really is important!$B$BThose are good odds!

f8fcbbda7d43fcc61110074d6742f2d0e1891ed8.LogDescription: Bring the items on Bath'rah's Parchment to Bath'rah the Windwatcher in Alterac.
f8fcbbda7d43fcc61110074d6742f2d0e1891ed8.QuestDescription: I have spent ages watching this site.  I watch, so that one day I might see the great Cyclonian fall.  But I have not yet found a champion to defeat the wind lord.$B$BPerhaps you are that champion.$B$BProve it to me.  Gather the items I need to summon Cyclonian, and I will know you are a great warrior.  Perhaps then you can defeat him and gain his whirlwind heart.$B$BIf so, then I will infuse the heart's power in a weapon, and I will give that weapon to you.$B$BHere is a parchment with the items I need.
